name: StereoLift Live
summary:
StereoLift Live transforms the content on your PC into stereoscopic 3D in real time and presents it on a virtual screen in your Meta Quest headset.

Navigate and control your desktop through a responsive, low-latency 2D view, then switch seamlessly to 3D when you are ready to watch. StereoLift Live brings the technology of our 3D conversion service at stereolift.com to live viewing on your own hardware without waiting for an offline conversion or storing a separate 3D video.
